<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex081012026-08-2003-45-22" status="unreviewed"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">mdzod 'grel</rs> las <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">sngon gyi slon kha 1</rs> na re lo ga pa'i shes pa'i yul du gyur pa ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin la lo ga las 'das pa'i ye+es dang de'i rdzas la thob pa'i ye shes kyi yul ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin | dang po ni bhun po ba lan rdzi nas mkhas pa la Di de'i bar rnam snang b rnams po de'i yul ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa'o |
<lb n="N003"/>
rig pa ji ltar ba don dam pa'i zhes bshad do || 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs> ni dpyad na rig sas me 'thad pa ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin la dpyad na rigs pas 'thad pa don dam gyi bden pa yin no gsu | bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi la mi mthun mchod la grub mthang smra ba <expan>thams cad</expan> pma yin cero | </seg></TEI>
